scheme_name: Theka Shramik Evan Hamaal Shramik Baahy Rogi Chikitsa Sahaayata Yojana
other_conditions: Applicant must be registered in any district of Chhattisgarh.
Applicants who have received benefits from any other parallel scheme of the State Government are not eligible.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹2,000 per eligible applicant.
